title: 第十章   死里逃生，收获颇丰
content_zh:
三日之后，“这是哪里？”躺在河岸上的琼霄艰难的睁开了眼睛，四处望了望，仔细的回想着先前的战斗，他被杜狼一掌打落悬崖，原本以为会粉身碎骨，可没想到掉入了悬崖之下的河中，从而被河水冲上岸，进而捡了一条命。“伤的好重！好狠的家伙，”感受着破损的身体琼霄咧咧嘴道。

    “得先找个山洞恢复一下，再做打算，”说着琼霄背着重剑拖着受伤的身体在路上前行着……

    “呼～身体已经好的七七八八了，”盘坐在山洞里的琼霄睁开了眼睛。“星力已经开始出现外溢的现象，看来是时候突破道化星境中期了！”感受着体内澎湃的星力琼霄清叹了口气。

    山洞内，少年双目垂闭，双手结印，呼吸间，宛若天成，，吸取着周围不断涌来的星力，“今日一定要突破到中期！”琼霄咬牙坚持道。

    周围的星力越发的撕扯着，琼霄的呼吸也逐渐急促起来，脸色也越发的涨红……

    琼霄眼眸骤然睁开，嘴巴微微张大，一口有些浑浊的气体，被吐了出来。

    浑浊的气体一离体，琼霄的脸庞顿时精神了几分，立即起身扭了扭脖子，随后发出一阵清脆的骨头声响，手掌微微握了握，一股充实的力量之感，使得琼霄嘴角挑起了一抹喜悦。

    “终于化星境中期了啊！”感受着体内澎湃的星力，琼霄非常满意，他终于不用再躲躲藏藏藏了。

    “先来看看手环中有哪些好货，”先前事态紧急，琼霄没来的急查看手环之内的东西，只是把几瓶丹药和一本武学收进了手环内。

    “黄极丹可使化星境后期突破到**境的几率大大增加！玄极丹可使**境巅峰突破到玄星境几率增加，地星丹，可使玄星境后期巅峰突破到地星境界几率增加……”

    琼霄越看越心惊：“这太不可思议了，这些丹药居然有如此夺天造化之功效！这丹药要是拿去拍卖，定有不菲的收入，难怪苍狼会那么保密，估计他也是想独吞这些丹药吧？现如今都落在了我手中，”琼霄嘴角微微一翘。
content_en:
Three days later, "Where is this?" Qiong Xiao, who was lying on the river bank, opened his eyes with difficulty, looked around, and carefully recalled the previous battle. He was knocked off the cliff by Du Lang's palm. He originally thought that he would be shattered to pieces, but he did not expect that he fell into the river under the cliff and was washed ashore by the river, thus saving his life. "The injury is so serious! What a cruel guy," Qiong Xiao grinned, feeling the damaged body.

    "We need to find a cave to recover first, and then make plans," Qiong Xiao said as he carried his heavy sword on his back and dragged his injured body along the road...

    "Huh! You're already feeling better," Qiong Xiao, who was sitting cross-legged in the cave, opened her eyes. "The star power has begun to overflow. It seems that it is time to break through to the middle stage of Daohua Star Realm!" Feeling the surging star power in his body, Qiong Xiaoqing sighed.

    In the cave, the young man closed his eyes, formed seals with his hands, and breathed as if created by nature, absorbing the star power that was constantly coming from around him. "We must break through to the mid-term today!" Qiong Xiao insisted through gritted teeth.

    The surrounding star power became more and more torn, Qiong Xiao's breathing gradually became more rapid, and his face became redder and redder...

    Qiong Xiao's eyes suddenly opened, her mouth opened slightly, and a mouthful of turbid gas was spit out.

    As soon as the turbid gas left the body, Qiong Xiao's face suddenly became more energetic. He immediately stood up and twisted his neck. Then there was a crisp sound of bones, and he clenched his hands slightly. A sense of substantial strength made Qiong Xiao's mouth twitch with joy.

    "We are finally in the middle stage of the Star Transformation Realm!" Feeling the surging star power in his body, Qiong Xiao was very satisfied. He finally no longer had to hide and hide.

    "Let's take a look at the good stuff in the bracelet first." The situation was urgent before. Qiong Xiao didn't come to check the contents of the bracelet. He just put a few bottles of elixirs and a martial arts book into the bracelet.

    "The Huangji Pill can greatly increase the probability of breaking through to the Xuanxing Realm in the late stage of the Star Transformation Realm! The Xuanji Pill can increase the chance of breaking through to the Xuanxing Realm from the peak of the Xuanxing Realm, and the Earth Star Pill can increase the chance of breaking through to the Earth Star Realm from the peak of the Xuanxing Realm in the late stage..."

    Qiong Xiao became more and more frightened as he watched: "This is unbelievable. These elixirs actually have such amazing effects! If these elixirs are auctioned, they will definitely earn a lot of money. No wonder Canglang keeps it so secretive. I guess he also wants to swallow these elixirs for himself, right? Now they are all in my hands," Qiong Xiao's mouth curled up slightly.
title_en: Chapter 10: Escape from death and gain a lot
